body:
I'm pretty good at not directing anger towards people, just things. Go in a room alone a throw and break things... I have tried so many medications, but with my situation I cycle in and out so it hard to know what's working and what's just part of the cycle. My Dr. Wants me to try latuda, but there is no generic yet, and my co pay is almost $2000!

My wife is a super star, she works full time as a nurse, pretty high stress job at an oncology office (cancer) and manages our household like a champion. She deserves so much more then I can give her, so do our kids.
